title: Transpacific Industries Group Ltd - acquisition of Roads & Robinson Rubbish & Recycling
industries: Municipal waste collection and recycling services

timeline.event: Transpacific Industries Group Ltd acquired Roads & Robinson Rubbish & Recycling.
ACCC commenced review under Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Transpacific Industries Group Ltd has acquired Roads & Robinson Rubbish & Recycling.
body_sections.Market definition: The acquisition was considered in the context of: -	Perth regional market for the collection and transportation of municipal waste; -	Perth regional market for the supply of waste recycling facilities -	WA markets for the supply of: -	recycled glass; -	recycled paper; -	recycled cardboard; -	recycled plastic (PET and HDPE); and -	recycled metals (steel and aluminium)
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC formed the view that the acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets due to a number of actual and potential competitors who would be likely to constrain the merged firm.
